title: Starship's Second Flight Test
description:
Starship returned to integrated flight testing with its second launch from Starbase in Texas. Starship executed a successful hot-stage separation, powering down all but three of Super Heavy’s Raptor engines and successfully igniting the six second stage Raptor engines before separating the vehicles. This was the first time this technique has been done successfully with a vehicle of this size.
Learn more on the mission page.
